focus_areas: Interface between cat fur and red flowers for edge bleeding
Natural formation and symmetry of the 'M' marking on the forehead
Consistency of eye reflections and lighting direction
Texture contrast between biological fur and artificial-looking flowers
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Focus heavily on the interface between the cat's fur and the red flowers, utilizing the bounding boxes provided by the detector. Verify if the 'M' marking is naturally formed by the stripe pattern or looks painted on. Check eye reflections for consistency with a single light source. Ensure the topology auditor uses the OVD priors to strictly segment the cat from the flowers to detect any fusion artifacts.
image_description: A close-up portrait of a brown tabby cat with distinct black stripes and an 'M' marking on its forehead. The cat has yellow-green eyes, a pink nose, and white whiskers. It is positioned next to bright red artificial flowers (possibly poinsettias) on the right side of the frame. The lighting highlights the texture of the fur and the sheen of the flower petals.
